alhamdulillah.name: Alhamdulillah
alhamdulillah.meaning: All praise is due to Allah

laIlahaIllallah.name: La ilaha illallah
laIlahaIllallah.meaning: There is no god but Allah

salawat.name: Salawat on the Prophet ﷺ
salawat.transliteration: Allahumma salli ala Muhammadin wa ala ali Muhammad
salawat.meaning: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

laHawla.name: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
laHawla.transliteration: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
laHawla.meaning: There is no power and no strength except with Allah

subhanAllahiWaBihamdihi.name: SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi
subhanAllahiWaBihamdihi.meaning: Glory be to Allah, and praise be to Him

tahlil.name: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu
tahlil.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul mulku wa lahul hamdu wa huwa ala kulli shay'in qadir
tahlil.meaning: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is able to do all things

audhuKalimat.name: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammati
audhuKalimat.transliteration: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq
audhuKalimat.meaning: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He created

hisn75a.name: Alhamdulillahi wahdah
hisn75a.transliteration: Alhamdulillahi wahdah was-salatu was-salam 'ala man la nabiyya ba'dah.
hisn75a.meaning: All praise is due to Allah alone, and peace and blessings be upon him after whom there is no other Prophet.

hisn77.name: Asbahna wa asbahal-mulku lillah
hisn77.transliteration: Asbahna wa asbahal-mulku lillah, walhamdu lillah, la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in Qadir. Rabbi as'aluka khayra ma fi hadha 'l-yawmi wa khayra ma ba'dahu wa a'udhu bika min sharri ma fi hatha 'l-yawmi wa sharri ma ba'dahu, Rabbi a'udhu bika minal-kasali, wa su'il-kibar, Rabbi a'udhu bika min 'adhabin fin-nari wa 'adhabin fil-qabr.
hisn77.meaning: We have entered a new day and with it all dominion is Allah's. Praise is to Allah. None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner. To Allah belongs the dominion, and to Him is the praise and He is Able to do all things. My Lord, I ask You for the goodness of this day and of the days that come after it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this day and of the days that come after it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and helpless old age. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of Hell-fire, and from the punishment of the grave.

hisn77e.name: Amsayna wa amsal-mulku lillah
hisn77e.transliteration: Amsayna wa amsal-mulku lillah, walhamdu lillah, la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in Qadir. Rabbi as'aluka khayra ma fi hathihil-laylati wa khayra ma ba'daha wa a'udhu bika min sharri ma fi hathihil-laylati wa sharri ma ba'daha, Rabbi a'udhu bika minal-kasali, wa su'il-kibar, Rabbi a'udhu bika min 'adhabin fin-nari wa 'adhabin fil-qabr.
hisn77e.meaning: We have ended another day and with it, all dominion is Allah's. Praise is to Allah. None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner. To Allah belongs the dominion, and to Him is the praise and He is Able to do all things. My Lord, I ask You for the goodness of this night and of the nights that come after it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this night and of the nights that come after it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and helpless old age. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of Hell-fire, and from the punishment of the grave.

hisn78.name: Allahumma bika asbahna
hisn78.transliteration: Allahumma bika asbahna, wa bika amsayna, wa bika nahya, wa bika namut, wa ilaykan-nushur.
hisn78.meaning: O Allah, by You we enter the morning and by You we enter the evening, by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the Final Return.

hisn78e.name: Allahumma bika amsayna
hisn78e.transliteration: Allahumma bika amsayna wa bika asbahna wa bika nahya wa bika namut wa ilaykal-masir.
hisn78e.meaning: O Allah, You bring us the end of the day as You bring us its beginning, You bring us life and You bring us death, and to You is our fate.

hisn79.name: Sayyid al-Istighfar
hisn79.transliteration: Allahumma anta Rabbi la ilaha illa ant, khalaqtani wa ana 'abduk, wa ana 'ala 'ahdika wa wa'dika mastata't, a'udhu bika min sharri ma sana't, abu'u laka bi ni'matika 'alay, wa abu'u bidhanbi faghfir li fa'innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa ant.
hisn79.meaning: O Allah, You are my Lord, there is none worthy of worship but You. You created me and I am your slave. I keep Your covenant, and my pledge to You so far as I am able. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I admit to Your blessings upon me, and I admit to my misdeeds. Forgive me, for there is none who may forgive sins but You.

hisn80.name: Allahumma inni asbahtu ush-hiduka
hisn80.transliteration: Allahumma inni asbahtu ush-hiduka wa ush-hidu hamalata 'arshik, wa mala'ikataka wajami'a khalqik, annaka antallahu la ilaha illa ant, wahdaka la sharika lak, wa anna Muhammadan 'abduka wa rasuluk.
hisn80.meaning: O Allah, I have entered a new morning and call upon You and upon the bearers of Your Throne, upon Your angels and all creation to bear witness that surely You are Allah, there is none worthy of worship but You alone, You have no partners, and that Muhammad is Your slave and Your Messenger.

hisn80e.name: Allahumma inni amsaytu ush-hiduka
hisn80e.transliteration: Allahumma inni amsaytu ush-hiduka wa ush-hidu hamalata 'arshik, wa mala'ikataka wajami'a khalqik, annaka antallahu la ilaha illa ant, wahdaka la sharika lak, wa anna Muhammadan 'abduka wa rasuluk.
hisn80e.meaning: O Allah, I have ended another day and call upon You and upon the bearers of Your Throne, upon Your angels and all creation to bear witness that surely You are Allah, there is none worthy of worship but You alone, You have no partners, and that Muhammad is Your slave and Your Messenger.

hisn81.name: Allahumma ma asbaha bi min ni'matin
hisn81.transliteration: Allahumma ma asbaha bi min ni'matin aw bi ahadin min khalqik, fa minka wahdaka la sharika lak, falaka 'l-hamdu wa lakash-shukr.
hisn81.meaning: O Allah, whatever blessing has been received by me or anyone of Your creation is from You alone, You have no partner. All praise is for you and thanks is to You.

hisn81e.name: Allahumma ma amsa bi min ni'matin
hisn81e.transliteration: Allahumma ma amsa bi min ni'matin aw bi ahadin min khalqik, fa minka wahdaka la sharika lak, falaka 'l-hamdu wa lakash-shukr.
hisn81e.meaning: O Allah, whatever blessing has come to me this evening or anyone of Your creation is from You alone, You have no partner. All praise is for you and thanks is to You.

hisn82.name: Allahumma 'afini fi badani
hisn82.transliteration: Allahumma 'afini fi badani, Allahumma 'afini fi sam'i, Allahumma 'afini fi basari, la ilaha illa ant. Allahumma inni a'udhu bika mina 'l-kufri, wa 'l-faqr, wa a'udhu bika min 'adhabi 'l-qabr, la ilaha illa ant.
hisn82.meaning: O Allah, make me healthy in my body. O Allah, preserve for me my hearing. O Allah, preserve for me my sight. There is none worthy of worship but You. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from disbelief and poverty, and I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave. There is none worthy of worship but You

hisn83.name: Hasbiyallahu la ilaha illa huwa
hisn83.transliteration: Hasbiyallahu la ilaha illa huwa 'alayhi tawakkalt, wa huwa Rabbu 'l-'Arshi 'l-'Azim.
hisn83.meaning: Allah is sufficient for me. There is none worthy of worship but Him. I have placed my trust in Him, He is Lord of the Majestic Throne.

hisn84.name: Allahumma inni as'alukal-'afwa wal-'afiyah
hisn84.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka 'l-'afwa wal-'afiyah fid-dunya wal-akhirah, Allahumma inni as'aluka 'l-'afwa wal-'afiyah fi dini wa dunyaya, wa ahli, wa mali, Allahummastur 'awrati, wa amin raw'ati, Allahummahfazni min bayni yadayya, wa min khalfi, wa 'an yamini, wa 'an shimali, wa min fawqi, wa a'udhu bi'azamatika an 'ughtala min tahti.
hisn84.meaning: O Allah, I seek Your forgiveness and Your protection in this world and the next. O Allah, I seek Your forgiveness and Your protection in my religion, in my worldly affairs, in my family and in my wealth. O Allah, conceal my secrets and preserve me from anguish. O Allah, guard me from what is in front of me and behind me, from my left, and from my right, and from above me. I seek refuge in Your Greatness from being struck down from beneath me.

hisn85.name: Allahumma 'alimal-ghaybi wash-shahadah
hisn85.transliteration: Allahumma 'alima 'l-ghaybi wash-shahadah fatir as-samawati wa 'l'ard, Rabba kulli shay'in wa malikah, ash-hadu an la ilaha illa ant, a'udhu bika min sharri nafsi, wa min sharrish-shaytani wa shirkih, wa an aqtarifa 'ala nafsi su'an, aw ajurrahu ila Muslim.
hisn85.meaning: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the evident, Maker of the heavens and the earth, Lord of everything and its Possessor, I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship but You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of my soul, and from the evil of Satan and his helpers. (I seek refuge in You) from bringing evil upon my soul and from harming any Muslim.

hisn86.name: Bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru ma'asmihi
hisn86.transliteration: Bismillahi 'l-ladhi la yadurru ma'a-smihi shay'un fil-'ardi wa la fis-sama' wa huwas-Sami 'ul-'Alim.
hisn86.meaning: In the Name of Allah, Who with His Name nothing can cause harm in the earth nor in the heavens, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

hisn87.name: Raditu billahi Rabba
hisn87.transliteration: Raditu billahi Rabba, wa bil-Islami dina, wa bi-Muhammadin (sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallama) nabiyya.
hisn87.meaning: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my religion, and with Muhammad (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) as my Prophet.

hisn88.name: Ya Hayyu ya Qayyum
hisn88.transliteration: Ya Hayyu ya Qayyumu birahmatika astaghith aslih li sha'ni kullah wa la takilni ila nafsi tarfata 'ayn.
hisn88.meaning: O Ever-Living One, O Eternal One, by Your mercy I call on You to set right all my affairs. Do not place me in charge of my soul even for the blinking of an eye (i.e. a moment).

hisn89.name: Asbahna wa asbahal-mulku lillahi Rabbil-'alamin
hisn89.transliteration: Asbahna wa asbahal-mulku lillahi Rabbil-'alamin, Allahumma inni as'aluka khayra hadhal-yawm, fathahu, wa nasrahu, wa nurahu, wa barakatahu, wa hudah, wa a'udhu bika min sharri ma fihi wa sharri ma ba'dah.
hisn89.meaning: We have entered a new day and with it all the dominion which belongs to Allah, Lord of all that exists. O Allah, I ask You for the goodness of this day, its victory, its help, its light, its blessings, and its guidance. I seek refuge in You from the evil that is in it, and from the evil that follows it.

hisn89e.name: Amsayna wa amsal-mulku lillahi Rabbil-'alamin
hisn89e.transliteration: Amsayna wa amsal-mulku lillahi Rabbil-'alamin, Allahumma inni as'aluka khayra hadhihil-laylah, fathaha, wa nasraha, wa nuraha, wa barakataha, wa hudaha, wa a'udhu bika min sharri ma fiha wa sharri ma ba'daha.
hisn89e.meaning: We have ended another day and with it all the dominion which belongs to Allah, Lord of all that exists. O Allah, I ask You for the goodness of this night, its victory, its help, its light, its blessings, and its guidance. I seek refuge in You from the evil that is in it, and from the evil that follows it.

hisn90.name: Asbahna 'ala fitratil-Islam
hisn90.transliteration: Asbahna 'ala fitrati 'l-Islam, wa 'ala kalimati 'l-ikhlas, wa 'ala dini nabiyyina Muhammadin (sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam), wa 'ala millati abina Ibrahim, hanifan Musliman wa ma kana mina 'l-mushrikin.
hisn90.meaning: We have entered a new day upon the natural religion of Islam, the word of sincere devotion, the religion of our Prophet Muhammad (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him), and the faith of our father Ibrahim. He was upright (in worshipping Allah), and a Muslim. He was not of those who worship others besides Allah.

hisn90e.name: Amsayna 'ala fitratil-Islam
hisn90e.transliteration: Amsayna 'ala fitrati 'l-Islam, wa 'ala kalimati 'l-ikhlas, wa 'ala dini nabiyyina Muhammadin (sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam), wa 'ala millati abina Ibrahim, hanifan Musliman wa ma kana mina 'l-mushrikin.
hisn90e.meaning: We have ended this day upon the natural religion of Islam, the word of sincere devotion, the religion of our Prophet Muhammad (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him), and the faith of our father Ibrahim. He was upright (in worshipping Allah), and a Muslim. He was not of those who worship others besides Allah.

hisn94.name: Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi 'adada khalqihi
hisn94.transliteration: Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi, 'adada khalqihi, wa rida nafsihi, wa zinata 'arshihi, wa midada kalimatihi.
hisn94.meaning: Glory is to Allah and praise is to Him, by the multitude of His creation, by His Pleasure, by the weight of His Throne, and by the extent of His Words.

hisn95.name: Allahumma inni as'aluka 'ilman nafi'an
hisn95.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka 'ilman nafi'a, wa rizqan tayyiba, wa 'amalan mutaqabbala.
hisn95.meaning: O Allah, I ask You for knowledge that is of benefit, a good provision, and deeds that will be accepted.

hisn96.name: Astaghfirullaha wa atubu ilayh
hisn96.meaning: I seek the forgiveness of Allah and repent to Him.

hisn98.name: Allahumma salli wa sallim 'ala nabiyyina Muhammad
hisn98.transliteration: Allahumma salli wa sallim 'ala nabiyyina Muhammad.
hisn98.meaning: O Allah, send blessings and peace upon our Prophet Muhammad.

sync.title: Cloud sync
sync.description: Keep a copy of your listening progress, zikir and stats in the cloud, and bring it to another device. There is no account: a key on this device identifies your copy, and nothing is uploaded until you press Sync.
sync.privacy: Only a hash of your key is stored, together with your data. No name, email or IP address is saved with it.

key.label: Your sync key
key.warning: Your key is a little story. Anyone who knows it can read and change your cloud copy. If you lose both the key and this browser’s data, the cloud copy can’t be recovered, so write it down somewhere safe.
key.fileText:
Tilawah sync key

{key}

To bring your progress, zikir and stats to another device, open {site}, go to Stats, choose “Restore from key” and type this sentence.
Keep this file private: anyone with the key can read and change your cloud copy.

restore.title: Restore from a key
restore.description: Type or paste the sync key from your other device, the short story such as “7 quiet golden camels…”. Its cloud data is merged with this device, and this device uses that key from now on.
restore.label: Sync key

delete.title: Delete your cloud data?
delete.description: The copy in the cloud is erased. The data on this device is kept, and the next sync uploads it again.

errors.offline: You’re offline. Your data on this device is safe; try again when you’re connected.
errors.invalid-key: That isn’t a valid sync key. Check that every word is spelled as shown, in the same order.
errors.rate-limited: Too many requests. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.too-large: Your data is too large to sync.
errors.rejected: The cloud couldn’t accept this data.
errors.not-configured: Cloud sync isn’t available right now.
errors.not-found: There is no cloud data for that key.
errors.conflict: The cloud copy kept changing. Try again.
errors.server: Something went wrong while syncing. Try again.

bookmarks.empty: Bookmark an ayah in Live Quran on the player page, or add a note to one, and it will be listed here.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.description: A gentle nudge for your zikir and your daily listening. They stay on this device.

listening.hint: Only if you haven’t reached your goal yet

reminders.blocked: Notifications are blocked for this site, so reminders appear on the Home page when you open the app.
reminders.unsupported: This browser can’t show notifications here, so reminders appear on the Home page when you open the app. On iPhone, add the app to your Home Screen first.
reminders.limit: Notifications appear while the app is open or running in the background. A reminder you miss waits on the Home page until you’ve done it or closed it.
